en.title: DNA Sequencing — Palindrome Transformation Cost
en.description:
For each contiguous substring of the string, compute the minimum number of characters to change so that the substring becomes a palindrome, then find the sum of these costs over all substrings. This site follows the original problem's in-order palindrome definition, so characters cannot be rearranged.

See below for this site's input format and constraints.
en.input: A single line containing a string dna of lowercase English letters only. The source gives no length limit; this site uses 1≤|dna|≤100000.
en.output: Output the sum of the palindrome change costs over all contiguous substrings.
en.explanation: For each position pair (i,j), if the characters differ, the pair appears as symmetric characters in min(i+1,n-j) substrings. The total weight can be computed in linear time; pairs of equal characters are grouped by character and subtracted using prefix sums and binary search.
